core_principle: Keep the operation catalog hierarchy separate from the order calculation tree. The catalog classifies reusable operations; the estimate tree places selected operation instances into a specific product, project scope, stage and cost group.
grouping_rules: The primary estimate view groups by scope, then product/assembly, stage, shop, post and operation.
The same line items may be summarized by product, stage, shop or post, but every summary must be derived from the same underlying line items and must not create duplicate amounts.
A composite/bundle is a reusable recipe of child operations/resources. Its displayed parent total equals the sum of children; the parent total is not added again when children are present.
For the same physical scope and segment, select either a composite tariff or its detailed children, never both.
Alternative machine routes, thickness variants, manual/machine methods and aggregate/detailed installation representations must be mutually exclusive for the same work package and physical segment.
Use a segment_id/work_package_id to distinguish different physical parts or site areas. Blank segment IDs belong to the same default segment and are checked for overlap.
Site installation and construction must remain separate from product manufacturing, even when linked to the same order or product.

fields.id: Stable internal identifier. Preserve source work ID when present; app-only operations get an internal ID and must not receive a fabricated source ID.
fields.source_work_id: Nullable reference to the source work number in Данные.xlsx.
fields.code: Human-readable source or internal operation code.
fields.name: Display name; source name remains separately stored when customized.
fields.scope: product_design | product_manufacturing | inhouse_assembly_and_finishing | packaging | site_installation | construction | external_subcontract.
fields.post_id: Work center/post reference; nullable only for genuinely non-post work.
fields.resource_type: labor | machine | operator_support | consumable | purchased_item | equipment_rental | subcontract | fixed_setup.
fields.unit: Authoritative unit from Данные.xlsx for source operations; explicit unit for app-only operations.
fields.quantity_basis: Physical measure and its boundary: area, length, contour length, cut, hole, piece, set, person-hour, machine-hour, sheet, trip, etc.
fields.calculation_method: direct_unit_rate | output_per_hour | crew_cycle | person_hours | machine_hours | operator_support | setup_per_batch | unique_program_prep | composite | external_quote | manual.

pricing.source_formula: Stored source formula text; not recalculated by UI

fields.quantity_rule: Input, calculated expression, or linked measurement; preserve full precision.
fields.market_evidence_refs: References to comparable external price evidence, with comparability notes.
fields.incompatible_in_same_work_package: List of operation IDs or codes that cannot be selected with this line for the same segment.
fields.status: confirmed | preliminary | missing | needs_review | inactive | out_of_scope.
fields.audit: Who/when changed source data, base price, current price, productivity or status.

new_operation_entry_workflow.rule: Decide whether the operation belongs to product design, in-house manufacturing, in-house assembly/finishing, site installation, construction or external subcontracting.
Check source ID, name synonyms, shop, post, unit and physical boundary. Reuse an existing operation or add a variant if only a parameter differs; do not create duplicates.
One operation must represent one physical action with one measurable output and one cost driver. If the description contains multiple independent actions, decompose it into atomic operations.
Place it under an existing shop and post whenever possible. New categories/posts require explicit evidence; missing source work is added to matching existing categories automatically.
Use the source unit. Define exactly what is measured and what is included. No implicit unit conversion; require an explicit conversion coefficient when dimensions differ.
Select direct rate, output/hour, crew cycle, person-hours, machine-hours, operator support, fixed batch setup, unique program preparation, composite or external quote.
Separate labor, machine, operator, consumables, purchased resources, equipment rental and subcontract costs. Identify which resources are already included elsewhere to avoid double counting.
Compare like-for-like operation, material, thickness, geometry, unit, batch size, setup, preparation and included resources. Competitor prices are benchmarks, not automatic internal rates.
Tag every value as dialogue, catalog, model or input; mark model-assigned norms as preliminary until measured or confirmed.
Check units, formula dimensions, duplicate scope, alternatives, cost components, price/cost separation and order-level markup before activating the operation.

direct_unit_rate.use_when: The source or approved tariff already defines a price per physical unit.

output_per_hour.formula: person_or_crew_hours = quantity / output_per_hour; labor_amount = hours * labor_rate
output_per_hour.requirement: Productivity basis must explicitly state person or crew.

crew_cycle.formula: person_hours = quantity * workers * cycle_minutes / 60; labor_amount = person_hours * labor_rate
crew_cycle.requirement: Cycle duration applies to one output unit and crew size is explicit.

person_hours.requirement: Use sum of time of all workers, not elapsed crew time.

machine_hours.formula: machine_hours = quantity / machine_output_per_hour OR explicit_cycle_time; machine_cost = machine_hours * machine_rate
machine_hours.requirement: Machine rate excludes separately calculated operator support.

operator_support.formula: operator_person_hours = machine_hours * operator_minutes_per_machine_hour / 60; operator_amount = operator_person_hours * operator_rate
operator_support.requirement: Separate line per CNC post; resolve same-employee overlapping intervals by interval union.

setup_per_batch.requirement: Charge once per actual batch, not once per unit.

unique_program_prep.formula: program_hours = unique_contour_length / programming_output_per_hour; program_amount = program_hours * programming_person_hour_rate
unique_program_prep.requirement: Charge once per unique program/contour set, not per repeated physical copy.

composite.requirement: Parent is a non-additive display total when child rows are included.

external_quote.requirement: Do not add in-house machine and operator costs for work performed by an external supplier.

order_markup.formula: applied once after all selected lines and bundles are consolidated

order_financial_rules.precision: Store full precision; display monetary values to 2 decimals.
order_financial_rules.missing_cost_handling: If any selected line has no planned cost basis, mark order cost/profit/margin as incomplete; never silently treat unknown cost as zero.

no_double_count_rules: Do not select an aggregate operation and its detailed child operations for the same scope.
Do not select two alternative machine routes for the same physical segment.
Do not count CNC operator support inside machine rate and again as a separate operator line.
Do not count one employee overlapping on multiple posts twice.
Do not charge unique drawings/programs once per repeated part when one prepared set is reused.
Do not count setup once per unit when the setup applies to a batch.
Do not apply height/winter multipliers to equipment rental, machine cost, materials, purchased items or subcontracting; the current model applies them only to eligible labor.
Do not add the composite parent total to the sum of its child operations.

provenance_and_ui.unit_change_warning: Единица измерения изменена на базовую. Требуется проверка стоимости и корректности расчёта
provenance_and_ui.unit_change_rule: Update unit from primary source, keep price unchanged, show warning until next configuration save; do not auto-convert quantities.
provenance_and_ui.missing_price_rule: Price numeric zero and text "по запросу" are treated as absent values, not as free operations.
provenance_and_ui.quantity_zero_rule: An empty quantity is not entered; numeric 0 is a known zero quantity.
provenance_and_ui.formula_rule: Store source formula and parameters separately; show the original formula text and explanatory substitution without recalculating the original Excel formula in the UI.
provenance_and_ui.precision_rule: Full internal precision; 2 decimals in display.

cnc_operator_support.overlap_handling: Union overlapping intervals per employee; sum different employees.
cnc_operator_support.source_original_tariff_note: Previous calculation artifact retains 2481 RUB as source_original_tariff metadata for work 103, while the user-confirmed working operator rate used in the calculation is 2081 RUB/person-hour. Keep source metadata and effective working rate in separate fields; do not conflate them.

program_preparation.note: Only genuinely unique program sets increase preparation quantity.

panel_saw_43.batches: 12 строк карты, толщина 3–30 мм по факту, чистый рез по одному слою
panel_saw_43.pricing: Ресурс станка и пил по метражу и рабочему времени, наладка и листы, полное время станочника, отдельно вспомогательный труд и разработка новой карты по потребности. 40% только в итоге всего заказа.
panel_saw_43.override: Чистое время цикла заменяет формулу. Измерение исключает наладку и подачу листа.

validation_rules: Reject missing unit, missing physical quantity basis or incompatible unit/productivity dimensions.
If productivity is missing or zero, do not invent it; require manual person-hours or mark the rate as missing.
Reject negative quantity, negative hours and invalid integer-only counts such as cuts, holes, sheets or packages.
Warn when the same segment has overlapping alternative routes or aggregate and detailed operations.
Require explicit batch/unique-program identity for setup and program preparation.
Require operator support line for every selected in-house CNC post with nonzero machine time.
For subcontracted work, suppress in-house machine and operator lines for the same physical operation.
Do not activate a model-assigned norm as confirmed without a measured or user-approved origin.
If a selected operation has a price but no planned cost basis, show price normally but mark profitability incomplete; do not report a false profit or margin.

source_tariff_reproduction.purpose: Reproduce historical catalog hourly tariffs only.

planned_labor_cost.purpose: Planned labor cost for profitability analysis. Replace budget parameters with actual accounting data when available.

labor_rate_financial_model.important: Do not mix source tariff reproduction with planned cost. The 40% markup is applied only once at order level and is not part of either hourly formula.

panel_saw_43_detail.physical_cut_length_rule: Count actual physical straight saw cuts. A shared edge between adjacent parts is one cut; do not add kerf width to the measured cut length.
panel_saw_43_detail.measured_cycle_override: A measured clean cutting cycle replaces the calculated cutting time and excludes setup, sheet loading and unloading.
panel_saw_43_detail.operator_rule: The format-saw operator is charged for the full manual cycle in ФРС.ОП. Do not create an additional CNC work-103 operator-support line for P43.
